name: outlook-local
description: Read mail and calendar from Legacy Outlook for Mac and create drafts only. Cannot send, delete, or move mail.
long_description: Local, dependency-free MCP server. Talks to Microsoft Outlook (Legacy Outlook) on this Mac through AppleScript, so it works with on-premises Exchange. No network access; no sending; drafts are opened for the user to review.

tools.name: list_folders
tools.description: List mail folders with unread counts

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: List recent messages in a folder

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search messages by subject or sender
